name: Guardian Demon Abomination
tactics: An abomination taunts its foes as it seizes a victim and crushes the life from it with its powerful tentacles. When a grabbed target’s life ebbs, the abomination tosses it aside and grabs for another victim.

alignment.name: Chaotic Evil
alignment.description:
Chaotic evil creatures have a complete disregard for others. They kill, steal, and betray others to gain power. Their word is meaningless and their actions destructive. Their worldviews can be so warped that they destroy anything and anyone that doesn’t directly contribute to their interests.
	By the standards of good and lawful good people, chaotic evil is as abhorrent as evil, perhaps even more so. Chaotic evil monsters such as demons and orcs are at least as much of a threat to civilization and general well-being as evil monsters are. An evil creature and a chaotic evil creature are both opposed to good, but they don’t have much respect for each other either and rarely cooperate toward common goals.
	For the purpose of game effects, a chaotic evil creature is also considered evil.

description: Creatures larger than Medium take up more than 1 square. For instance, an ogre takes up a space that is 2 squares by 2 squares. Most Large and larger creatures also have a reach greater than 1, which means they can make melee attacks against creatures that aren’t adjacent to them. A creature’s basic body shape usually determines its reach; a Large ogre has a reach of 2, but a Large horse has a reach of 1.

traits.name: Abominable Horror
traits.details: Any enemy that ends its turn within the aura is marked by the guardian demon abomination until the end of the abomination’s next turn.

traits.name: All-Around Vision
traits.details: Enemies can’t gain combat advantage by flanking the abomination.

auras.name: Abominable Horror
auras.details: Any enemy that ends its turn within the aura is marked by the guardian demon abomination until the end of the abomination’s next turn.

powers.name: Tentacle Seize
powers.requirements: Requirement: The abomination must not have a creature grabbed.

hit.description: damage, and the abomination pulls the target 1 square. If the target ends that movement adjacent to the abomination, the abomination grabs the target. The target takes a -4 penalty to attempts to escape the grab.

effect.description: The abomination sustains a grab. The grabbed creature takes 1d8 + 4 necrotic damage, and the abomination can make a saving throw against one effect that a save can end.

powers.name: Variable Resistance
powers.trigger: The abomination takes acid, cold, fire, lightning, or thunder damage.

effect.description: The abomination gains resist 5 to the triggering damage type until the end of the encounter or until it uses variable resistance again.
